prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1414; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are far more than the damage needs, about three times a normal estimate.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center with the left tail lamp assembly broken, and the trunk lid shows a crease consistent with the reported rear impact. The damage pattern lines up with the described collision, and nothing I found points to earlier damage on this vehicle. The plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp, refinishing the trunk lid, and checking the rear panel for hidden deformation. The labor hours requested run roughly three times what a job of this scope normally needs, so I have asked the shop to justify each operation line by line before approval. The invoices and parts records I reviewed show no repeated charges.
